ui_bugs.issue: Non-money integers are still passed through toLocaleString('en-AE'), so the 'year' KPI tile renders as '2,026' instead of '2026'. Suggest skipping grouping for keys matching /year|quarter|month|count|pct|rate/.

The 'sales' column renders raw '18610.58' (no thousand separator / 2dp) because the money regex in fmtVal does not include 'sales' (and the backend likely returns it as a string). Add 'sales|expense|debit|credit|price|fee' to the money keyHint regex and Number()-coerce numeric strings.

scrollIntoView is attached to the inner preview-body div, so for long reports (expenses, expense-ledger, sales-journal) the panel header 'Preview — X' and the Close button end up ~69px above the viewport top. Content is visible so the user symptom is fixed, but attaching the ref to [data-testid=report-preview] (or block:'center') would keep the header + Close visible.
